description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX socket accept behavior, including invalid socket, no connection, not bound, and not listening scenarios, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: RainyDayInvalidSocket
methods.description: Tests accept() with an invalid socket descriptor (-1), expecting failure.

methods.name: RainyDayNoConnection
methods.description: Sets up a listening socket and verifies accept() times out when no connection is made.

methods.name: RainyDayNotBound
methods.description: Tests accept() on a socket that is not bound, expecting failure.

methods.name: RainyDayNotListening
methods.description: Sets up a socket that is bound but not listening, and verifies accept() fails.
